purpose: One typed envelope for every contributor — human, Hermes, ChatGPT, Codex, or local worker. Making a contribution to FIELD is itself a FIELD operation; switching crew mates must preserve the same addressed object, bounded move options, evidence and RETURN without transferring hidden state or authority.
sequence: SOURCE → SUBMISSION OBJECT → HOST RESOLUTION → HOLD → TURN → TRACE → RETURN

required.source_ref: Where this came from (conversation id, file, URL, observation)
required.intent: What the contributor is trying to make happen
required.delta_or_question: The smallest observable change, or the open question
required.proof_available: What evidence exists at handoff time; this may still be unverified

optional.contributor_ref: Informational sender label such as human:<name>, chatgpt:<thread>, codex:<run>, hermes:<worker>; never authority
optional.receiver_hint: Informational intended receiver/capability hint; never routing or priority authority
optional.host_candidates: Candidate hosts from FIELD INDEX (if object_ref is UNRESOLVED)
optional.axial_support: Support values from AXIAL host resolution
optional.residue: What remains unresolved after this submission
optional.return_to: Exact re-entry address when it differs from object_ref
optional.execution: Optional bounded SOURCE/HOLD projection defined below

execution.purpose: Carry enough explicit state for another crew mate to continue without reconstructing intent, while refusing to serialize hidden reasoning or invent effect authority.

optional_fields.selected_move_id: Optional explicit selection of exactly one declared move; selection itself grants no effect authority
optional_fields.evidence_refs: Exact refs the receiver can re-read or verify
optional_fields.source_witness: Optional optimistic-concurrency witness for a handoff expected to survive another worker/turn. Supported form: {kind:'GIT_BLOB', path:'repo/relative/path', revision:'40-hex git blob sha'}. Freshness evidence only; never authority.

move.id: Stable local move identifier; generated from position only when omitted
move.law: EFFECT remains inert until the native host's explicit RELEASE/commit boundary is crossed.

minimum_execution_projection.purpose: Smallest executable same-object packet for a human, agent, or future crew member after host/object resolution. It is a projection of this contract plus SOURCE→HOLD→TURN→TRACE→RETURN, not a new planner, queue, memory or authority source.

source.owner: Native authority that owns truth/effect for this object

hold.delta: One observable before→after change or question

turn.release: NONE for non-effect work; otherwise the exact native commit/RELEASE boundary

trace.evidence: Zero or more exact evidence refs; empty evidence cannot justify CHANGED/UNCHANGED behavioral claims

return.gate: null or the exact unresolved human/device/world/policy/evidence gate
return.to: Exact re-entry address for the same object/context

invariants: source.object is immutable across the packet; a different object requires a new SOURCE.
source.owner is native authority, not the current human/model/worker identity.
hold.delta names one observable change; it does not become priority or NEXT authority.
turn.move is exactly one operation. A second move requires RETURN then a fresh HOLD.
turn.release must be NONE unless the native host explicitly owns the named commit/RELEASE boundary.
trace.status never implies proof by itself; evidence supports material claims and UNKNOWN is valid.
return.gate preserves what still blocks truth/effect without occupying NOW.
RETURN closes authority. There is deliberately no next field and no actor field.

hold.delta: Make one existing reader action reachable with less interaction cost without changing source/cursor authority

turn.move: Patch the existing /docs/ host action surface

trace.result: Existing action is reachable from the current surface; source/cursor authority unchanged

minimum_execution_projection.intake_boundary: Use the full submission envelope when object_ref is UNRESOLVED, host resolution is still required, donor/contribution classification matters, or evidence class/source provenance must be established. Once one exact object+owner are resolved, the minimum projection is sufficient for bounded execution/handoff.
minimum_execution_projection.compiler_law: Compiler runs crew-handoff + source-witness preflight, resolves native owner from showcase-manifest.json, and emits only when state is TURN_READY. '-' reads one JSON submission from stdin. No state is written.

states.SOURCE_REQUIRED: object_ref is unresolved OR a supplied source witness is unverified/stale/missing; receiver must establish one exact current host/object before action
states.HOLD_REQUIRED: object is resolved but no moves are declared; receiver derives 1–3 host-native moves
states.HOLD_READY: 1–3 native moves are declared; one may be deliberately selected
states.TURN_READY: one declared move is selected; native effect/commit authority is still not transferred
states.HUMAN_REQUIRED: An explicit PING/CHOOSE/WORLD_RETURN remains unsatisfied, OR a selected EFFECT still carries an UNSPECIFIED human gate. Receiver may prepare/reduce but cannot expose TURN_READY until the gate is explicit; gate resolution never grants effect authority.

crew_handoff_projection.identity: A deterministic opaque crew:<fnv64> handle is derived from source_ref + intent + object_ref + contribution_class + evidence_class + delta_or_question. It correlates the same handoff object without becoming a task database or session authority.
crew_handoff_projection.statelessness: The compiler reads one submission and emits one transient projection. It writes no queue, task store, memory, CURRENT, manifest or native host state.
crew_handoff_projection.human_agent_parity: The text and JSON projections carry the same SOURCE/HOLD/TRACE/RETURN facts. Human and machine readers differ in presentation, not object identity or authority.
crew_handoff_projection.interop_correspondence: Design correspondence only: explicit task/context handles and evidence artifacts resemble A2A task handoff; transient explicit handles and capability/resource separation resemble current MCP practice. FIELD does not claim A2A or MCP protocol conformance from this projection.

source_witness.purpose: Detect same-object source drift between crew mates before a selected TURN.
source_witness.verify: When execution.source_witness is present, --handoff re-hashes the local repo file as a Git blob before exposing TURN_READY.
source_witness.law: STALE/MISSING fails closed to SOURCE_REQUIRED. Witness identity never grants permission, priority, merge, commit or effect authority.

laws: HANDOFF PRESERVES INTENT + ADDRESS + 0–3 BOUNDED MOVES + EVIDENCE POINTERS + RETURN.
HANDOFF DOES NOT SERIALIZE PRIVATE CHAIN OF THOUGHT, HIDDEN MEMORY OR TOOL INTERNALS.
CONTRIBUTOR / RECEIVER LABELS ARE INFORMATIONAL; THEY NEVER GRANT NOW, PRIORITY, HOST, EFFECT OR MERGE AUTHORITY.
ZERO MOVES IS VALID. IT MEANS HOLD_REQUIRED, NOT PERMISSION TO INVENT A PROJECT.
MORE THAN THREE MOVES FAILS CLOSED.
A SELECTED TURN ON AN UNRESOLVED OBJECT FAILS CLOSED.
RETURN CLOSES AUTHORITY; NEXT_AUTHORITY IS NONE UNTIL CURRENT IS RE-READ.
SOURCE WITNESS != OBJECT IDENTITY OR AUTHORITY. IT IS AN OPTIONAL OPTIMISTIC-CONCURRENCY GUARD; STALE/MISSING HANDOFFS RETURN TO SOURCE_REQUIRED.
UNSPECIFIED HUMAN GATE + SELECTED EFFECT FAILS CLOSED TO HUMAN_REQUIRED; EXPLICIT NONE OR A SATISFIED EXPLICIT GATE IS REQUIRED BEFORE EFFECT CAN PROJECT TURN_READY.

contribution_classes.DELTA: Changes an existing head. Requires a named host.
contribution_classes.EVIDENCE: Tests or observes an existing claim. Requires the claim it tests.
contribution_classes.DONOR: Supplies a mechanism to an existing head without replacing it.
contribution_classes.RETURN: Records observed behavior of a completed run.
contribution_classes.UNRESOLVED: No host yet. Held for review, not promoted. This is a valid outcome.

host_resolution.rule: A contribution must resolve to a host in FIELD INDEX before promotion or selected TURN.
host_resolution.zero_host: Zero obvious host means UNRESOLVED submission, not automatic new project.
host_resolution.method: AXIAL-style exact support against showcase-manifest.json objects — not project-name intuition, not fake scalar scoring.

example.intent: Reduce one concrete reader friction without reconstructing project context
example.delta_or_question: Make one current READFIELD action easier to reach without changing source/cursor authority

crew_turn_projection.purpose: Smallest directly pipeable same-object execution handoff. TRACE begins UNKNOWN / NOT_EXECUTED and must be replaced by observed evidence after native TURN.
crew_turn_projection.readiness: Only TURN_READY handoffs project. Other states fail closed.
crew_turn_projection.owner_resolution: Native owner comes from showcase-manifest route.field.owner; FIELD root resolves to FIELD INDEX. Missing owner fails closed.
crew_turn_projection.stdin: Use '-' to read one submission JSON object from stdin; no transient handoff file is required.
crew_turn_projection.law: Transport/compression only; it never grants native RELEASE, NOW, merge or effect authority.

crew_response_projection.purpose: Minimal receiver read-back over the same field-crew-handoff/v0.1 object so crew can repair framing without replaying a transcript or creating shared task/memory state.

actions.KEEP: Frame is sufficient for otherwise-lawful continuation on the same object. Not EFFECT/merge/publish/NOW/priority approval.
actions.PARK: Retain as residue/later possibility and stop active continuation. Not deletion or rejection of source truth.
actions.WRONG_FRAME: Frame is not sufficient for continuation. Re-SOURCE/re-HOLD before any TURN; do not silently repair then continue.

invariants: context_handle and object_ref are preserved exactly from the handoff
response never mutates the handoff or native host
KEEP cannot grant EFFECT, merge, publish, NOW or priority authority
WRONG_FRAME returns coordination to SOURCE_REQUIRED semantics
response is transient; do not commit it as a shared memory/task store
